name: The Crooked House
summary: Dinner at the Druskenvalds' new house on the hill goes wrong: the house is not what it seems, and the Lord and Lady are gone.

stages.journal: Phillip asked us to dine at his new house on the hill above Wickermoor, and we promised to come. The evening is waiting.
stages.hint: Take the road up the hill out of the village.

stages.journal: We reached the gate. The caretakers were off to town for supplies, polite and a little uneasy, and a grey cat watched us from the hedge. Beyond them, the house did not look as it had from the road.
A tall, crooked man in a bent hat welcomed us onto the porch, the sky turned black, and the door shut behind us. The storm will not let us out, and neither Phillip nor Adela has come to the door.
objectives: Find a way out of the house
stages.hint: Search the house. The parlour has a spirit board.

stages.journal: The house is crowded with the ghosts of the family who died here, and each one keeps a small keepsake. Six of them, we are told, open the way to what holds the Druskenvalds, and there is one on every floor.
objectives: Win the six keepsakes of the Lockwood household
stages.hint: The household's ghosts each guard one keepsake, on every floor.

stages.journal: In the trophy room, a trapdoor hides in the ceiling. Above it is a cramped landing, a glowing door, and a ward with six empty circles cut into the stone.
objectives: Open the ward on the attic landing
stages.hint: Set the six keepsakes into the runes on the attic landing.

stages.journal: The ward is down. Behind the door something is cooking, and someone is waiting.
stages.hint: Face the hag in the cauldron room.

stages.journal: Vessla is dead and the Lord and Lady are awake, remembering little but a dinner and bad dreams. The house has eased into a gentler, still-odd shape, and the storm has gone. Scratched into the attic wall are the names of her sisters.
